value_blindness: committed before any stack-identification matrix comparison and before any KLF12 value of any candidate reference (or of ADOC) was read; no Cell Ranger run has been made; no value-derived artifact exists
reason: C4 pre-flight inspection of the E-MTAB-15842 deposit: all_feature_bc_matrix_features.tsv is a single column of Seurat feature row names, so the frozen comparison 'feature id, name, type, order' cannot be evaluated literally; the IDF records no Cell Ranger version, FASTA or count parameters. Owner decision 2026-09-26: freeze the execution choices below as amendment 13
kind_of_change: COMPARABILITY ACCEPTANCE-CRITERION ADJUSTMENT (not wording): the feature-universe criterion of comparability.pinned_stack.reference_genome is redefined as below; the reference build and count parameters left implicit by the pre-registration are frozen

observed.shape: 78,724 rows, one tab-free column; no feature id or feature type column; 35,997 rows are bare Ensembl gene ids (genes whose GENCODE gene_name equals the id); 1,620 rows carry R make.unique '.N' suffixes

feature_identity.criterion: the reference feature-universe check passes iff the deposited feature names, in order, equal exactly the reconstructed GENCODE v47 feature sequence: every gene record of gencode.v47.annotation.gtf.gz (chromosome-only annotation), in GTF order, named by gene_name, with duplicate names resolved by R-compatible make.unique
feature_identity.rebuilt_reference_requirement: the rebuilt Cell Ranger reference's features must be those same GENCODE v47 genes, one-to-one with the deposited rows in the same order, each with its GENCODE v47 gene id (version suffix as Cell Ranger emits it) and feature type 'Gene Expression'
feature_identity.id_and_type: feature id and feature type are reconstructed from the frozen annotation, not compared with deposited columns, which do not exist
feature_identity.diagnostic_at_freeze: 78,724 / 78,724 names in order match exactly (value-blind: gene names only)

fasta_and_annotation.not_used: GRCh38.p14.genome.fa.gz (alternate haplotypes) and gencode.v47.primary_assembly.annotation.gtf.gz (78,932 genes, not the deposited 78,724)
fasta_and_annotation.rule: the local md5 of every downloaded source must equal the published md5 before mkref runs

reference_build: each candidate Cell Ranger release builds its own reference with that release's own `cellranger mkref`, from exactly the FASTA and GTF above, with otherwise default settings (no GTF filtering); the Cell Ranger version is the only variable in the frozen stack search
count_parameters: each candidate release runs `cellranger count` at that release's defaults: chemistry autodetection, default cell calling and default intron behaviour; --expect-cells and --force-cells are not specified; --create-bam false is allowed (output suppression; it does not alter the count matrices compared)
search: unchanged: Cell Ranger releases in the frozen order starting at 9.0.1 (comparability.stack_identification.search_order); the first complete stack satisfying the frozen whole-matrix raw and filtered reproduction AND the pinned decontX reproduction (identical barcodes, max absolute entrywise difference <= 1e-6) is the pinned stack; if none passes, BLOCKED_COMPARABILITY
no_tuning: no setting above is retried, tuned or changed after any matrix result is seen
value_blindness_of_the_test: unchanged: whole-matrix comparisons only; no ADOC or candidate KLF12 value is extracted, inspected or summarised during stack identification
unchanged: candidate selection, donor and population rules, KLF12 measurement (quantity, layer, per-cell table), the derivation, S1-S5, thresholds, variants, stopping and verdict rules; the amendment-05 frozen citation; the owner's B1/B2 resolution; every other rule of amendments 01-12. No code changes; amendment 12's pins are carried verbatim
implementation_pin_authority: amendment 12; this amendment carries its pinned_implementation_sha256 verbatim

frozen_threshold_derivation_citation.rule: at C5 the definition file's threshold_derivation is exactly this string, byte for byte; any other value is a deviation. It must pass Phase 2A RR14's repository-citation check (_repository_citation) against the frozen definition pre-registration

candidate_selection.rule: qualification.select(inventory, min_reference_donors=3): metadata-only D1/D2/D5/D8 qualification, then the D7 order
candidate_selection.fallthrough: a VALUE-BLIND failure of the selected candidate (retrieval checksum, pipeline reproduction, reprocessing, donor-label join, fewer than min_reference_donors donors with cells) passes to the next candidate in the frozen order; a VALUE-AWARE failure (derive() returns NO_STABLE_SEPARATION) never does, because trying candidates until one separates would select a reference by its KLF12 distribution
candidate_selection.next_candidates: none: C03 is the only metadata-qualified candidate

rr14_citations.evidence_citation: E-MTAB-10283 (the reference dataset the state separation is measured in), evidence_kind reference_state_separation
rr14_citations.comparability_evidence: doi:10.5281/zenodo.17412607 (the ADOC pipeline code and lock file) together with the committed stack-identification result

verdict_rules: NO_SUITABLE_REFERENCE: no candidate qualifies on metadata; or every qualified candidate fails a value-blind check that is not a comparability failure; or derive() returns NO_STABLE_SEPARATION
BLOCKED_COMPARABILITY: no Cell Ranger stack passes the stack-identification test, or the pinned stack cannot process the selected candidate and no later candidate exists
BLOCKED_OWNER_DECISION: derive() qualifies but a requirement needs an owner decision not yet taken (owner acceptance under RR12, or activation of config/personalization.yaml)

QUALIFIED_REFERENCE_FOUND: derive() qualifies and phase2a_contract.evaluate_reference, run on the committed reference files with the manifest named in memory, reports no RR01-RR12 or RR14 failure other than the RR10 activation clause that only the owner's activation commit can satisfy; it enables assumption_conditioned_scenario mapping only, RR13 stays unmet, and no donor-specific model is produced
